1 تَسَعَهُمْ , aor.
تَسَعَ (S, Msb, K) and
تَسِعَ (Yoo, Msb, K) and
تَسُعَ , (Msb,) inf. n. تَسْعٌ, (T K,) He took the ninth part of their possessions: or he became the ninth of them: (S, Msb, K:) or he made them to be nine with himself; (K;) they having before been eight. (TA.) [See also 2.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
